blocks.text: BULAKAN, Bulacan— Bulakan officials last week commemorated the 150th birth anniversary of a revolutionary hero, whom the new generation needs to know again: Gen. Anacleto “Matanglawin” Enriquez. Bulakan Mayor Vergel Meneses led a wreath-laying ceremony before the hero’s bust inside the San Francisco Elementary School on Friday. Enriquez was born on September 25, 1876, and was killed in battle at the age of 20 years old inside the San Rafael town church along with hundreds of revolutionary troops and civilians 129 years ago on Nov. 30, 1896.
